# Team tools
**Status:** draft

**Recommended.** Every incident gets one of four severities: **Sev-1**, Sev-2, Sev-3, or Sev-4.
See [setup](guides/setup.md), [the glossary](reference/glossary.md#terms), and [the policy](https://example.com/handbook).

## How reviews work

Reviews take 3 days on average and cover 26 documents. The sync agent
*reduces exposure but is not a sandbox*.

- Open the review
  - Attach the fact skeleton
  - Attach the voice spec
- Wait for two verifiers

1. First pass

2. Second pass

---

> Only public or fully synthetic data goes into the hosted service.
